method: Python re-implementation: OLS slope; SciPy BCa bootstrap, 1,000 resamples, 200 seeds
summary: The slope is borderline (p = 0.058; classical CI -0.0072 to 0.4045). An independent BCa bootstrap excludes zero in 46% of 200 seeds. In the authors' own CSVs the CI excludes zero for 7/10 seeds under R 3.5.0 and 3/10 under R 3.6.1. The numbers do change with the R version, but whether the CI excludes zero depends on the seed in both versions.
